Both paths render a self-contained Now/Next/Later kanban to roadmap.html and finish with a short receipt.

# Approach — TaskPal

## What we're building

A minimal solo-founder task app with a fast keyboard-first capture flow.

## Features

### User authentication
- Problem: Users need a secure private account to keep their tasks.
- Value: Unblocks all persistence and sync.
- Dependencies: database setup

### Quick capture
- Problem: Adding a task takes too many taps today.
- Value: A single keyboard shortcut captures a task from anywhere.
- Dependencies: user authentication

### Weekly review view
- Problem: Users lose track of what they finished.
- Value: A read-only weekly digest of completed tasks.
- Dependencies: none

## Constraints

- Use Postgres.
- Mobile-first.

## Principles

- Ship weekly.

## Open questions

1. Should the weekly review be emailed or in-app only? — affects notification work.

assertions.text: The agent detects ./docs/approach.md exists (references an artifact-scan preflight or equivalent detection) before choosing a path
The agent takes the approach path: it does NOT invoke or delegate to the grill-with-docs skill
The agent does NOT ask the user to paste a conversation and does NOT re-parse source conversation text
The agent asks light prioritisation questions to assign the approach doc's features to Now / Next / Later
A self-contained roadmap.html is written with three columns (Now / Next / Later) and no JavaScript
The three features from approach.md (user authentication, quick capture, weekly review view) each appear as a card
The open question about emailed vs in-app weekly review is carried forward into the Open Questions section verbatim
The finishing receipt notes the source was ./docs/approach.md and that it was left unmodified

evals.name: conversation-only-runs-grilling
evals.prompt:
turn this into a roadmap:

Me: I want to build a small habit tracker. Definitely need accounts so people can save streaks.
AI: Makes sense. What about reminders?
Me: Yeah reminders are a must, push notifications.
AI: And you mentioned analytics earlier?
Me: We talked about a stats dashboard but I'm not sure. Maybe later. Also I decided we're NOT doing social sharing, that's out of scope.
AI: Got it. Anything on onboarding?
Me: There should be some onboarding but I haven't thought it through.
evals.expected_output: Because ./docs/approach.md does NOT exist, the skill takes the conversation path: it parses the transcript into decided / discussed / discarded / open-question buckets, runs an alignment grilling pass via grill-with-docs on the ambiguous items (stats dashboard, onboarding), drops only the explicitly rejected social sharing, and renders a Now/Next/Later kanban to roadmap.html with open questions flagged.

assertions.text: The agent determines ./docs/approach.md does not exist and takes the conversation path
The agent runs an alignment grilling pass (invokes or delegates to grill-with-docs) on ambiguous items such as the stats dashboard and onboarding
Committed features (accounts/streaks, reminders / push notifications) appear as cards on the board
Social sharing is dropped (it was explicitly rejected) and is not rendered as a card
The ambiguous stats dashboard and under-thought onboarding are surfaced for clarification (grilled or flagged as open questions), not silently dropped
A self-contained roadmap.html is written with Now / Next / Later columns and no JavaScript
The agent does NOT create or write ./docs/approach.md
The finishing receipt notes the feature distribution and what was excluded (only the actively rejected social sharing)
